definitions.coins: The 100 largest coins by market cap on CoinGecko, on every chain, in CoinGecko's order; rank is CoinGecko's market-cap rank.
definitions.bubble: Bubble size: market cap — each bubble's area is the coin's market cap, so a coin twice the size has twice the area. A coin with no market cap is listed and not drawn.
definitions.colour: Colour: the 24 h price change, in the legend's nine steps; a coin CoinGecko gives no change for is outlined and hatched ("no 24 h change given"), never drawn as 0%.
definitions.change24h: CoinGecko's change in the coin's US-dollar price over the last 24 hours, in percent (−5.27 means down 5.27%); null with why when CoinGecko gives none, never 0.
definitions.dominance: The coin's market cap as a share of CoinGecko's total market cap of every coin it lists, in percent (59.6 means 59.6%; its /global read, every 30 minutes, which the label names). Worked out by this site from CoinGecko's two figures, and as old as the older of them (its at); none when the market cap is not CoinGecko's own, or the total and the coins were read more than 2 hours apart.
definitions.volume24h: CoinGecko's trading volume over the last 24 hours, every market it tracks.
definitions.stable: true when CoinGecko files the coin in its stablecoins category (read every 6 hours); null until that list has been read.
definitions.check: The market cap checked against CoinLore's 100 largest coins, by the chain market caps' rules (lib/chainmcap.js): its coin counts when its symbol, name and price (within 10%) are CoinGecko's on the same read — for a coin under $0.0001, whose price CoinLore rounds to 6 decimal places, CoinLore's own market cap ÷ circulating supply is the price compared; "agreed" within 10%, "differs" (the notes say why from the numbers), "single" (one source; the notes say why).
definitions.total: CoinGecko's total market cap of every coin it lists — not only the 100 drawn.

notes: Not advice, never a tip to buy. Do your own research.
The 100 largest coins by market cap on CoinGecko, on every chain, read every 10 minutes; CoinGecko's total market cap every 30 minutes; its stablecoins category every 6 hours.

Each market cap is looked up in CoinLore's 100 largest coins: 65 of these 100 were found there and compared (33 agree, 32 differ by more than 10%); 35 have one source — the chip on each coin says which.
